name: ProductionCostReportWorkbench
tagline: The weekly film & TV cost report – budget, actuals, POs, ETC and EFC – reviewed and locked inside Power Apps.
description: A complete production-accounting app in one PCF control: dashboard KPIs, a grouped weekly cost report with inline ETC entry, an EFC movement bridge with mandatory variance notes, purchase-order approvals with a producer approval limit, a searchable list with bulk status changes, and a review workflow up to the weekly lock and roll-forward. Demo data works the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen or model-driven form.
features: EFC = actual + committed + ETC per account
PO approval limit with producer sign-off and reject with reason
Open → Submitted → Queried → Reviewed → Locked workflow
Weekly cost report lock and roll-forward
CSV export, bulk status, search, filters, grouping
